issues.on_page: Student support services 399,112 = General 203,521 + Other Governmental 195,591
issues.issue: The 195,591 in the Other Governmental column is Activities Fund spending (p15 'Other expenses' 195,591), which would be 'student activities'. The extractor kept it as one printed line and mentioned it in notes; splitting it by column would be more accurate. Judgment call.

The statement's 'Operation and maintenance of plant' total (405,254 General) includes this 7,366, so the function is Building and Grounds. As facilities acquisition, it could also be capital outlay. Plain 'support services' matches neither.
The statement line (receipts[15]) for the same 66,289 uses 'School Lunch Sales', which is also the user rule for lunch and meal sales. The detail line doesn't match.
